reply_text:
I answered Marcus in a thread on their message in #north-team: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

The source is Dana's post in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025, a channel Marcus belongs to. Dana wrote that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. The same trailer was showing up twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and then dispatch added him manually. I told Marcus that Dana owns the account and has the screenshots.

Thea's title, Director of Yard Operations, comes from a GBrain note written for Ruth rather than from the channel. Contacts count as operational facts, so sharing it with someone on the North team is allowed.
